buttons.title: Desk button
buttons.intro: What each gesture does. Default: 1 click = one glass of water. The click window is 400 ms; a long press is ≥ 1 s.

hint.water_add: Logs the given millilitres of water.
hint.ha_service: Calls a Home Assistant service, optionally on one entity.
hint.intercom_open: Opens the door while the intercom is ringing.
hint.intercom_arm: Auto-opens the door for the next N minutes (courier, guest).
hint.turzx_next: Switches the Turzx screen to the next view.
hint.turzx_pause: Pauses or resumes the Turzx rotation.

intercom.title: Intercom
intercom.description: Electra IA02 · doorbell on the phone, remote open

toast.armedFor: Auto-open for {n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}

intercom.footnote: Opening only works while it rings (the AVP line is powered only during a call). Every open is in the audit log.

copilot.title: Copilot signals
copilot.summary: {events, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} · {lights, plural, one {# bulb} other {# bulbs}} · quiet {from}–{to}
copilot.saveFirst: Save first — the test uses the saved settings
copilot.intro: Bulbs, the Turzx screen, the ESP32 and the phone react to what the agent does in VS Code.
copilot.noLights: No RGB bulb in Home Assistant yet. Pair the Calex bulbs in Smart Life; they show up here automatically.
copilot.eventsHint: What lights up, where, in which colour.

ask.label: Waiting for an answer
ask.hint: askQuestions — bulbs: aggressive pulse; strip: a bright dot runs along the frame until you answer

done.label: Turn finished
done.hint: Stop — bulbs: calm fade; strip: a green wave climbs both sides and fades out

blocked.label: Command blocked
blocked.hint: guard (git add -A, reset --hard…) — bulbs: 3 flashes; strip: 2 red waves from the top centre

failed.label: Build/test failed
failed.hint: run-build.ps1 exit ≠ 0 — bulbs: 2 flashes; strip: 2 yellow double blinks
